name: xrdp
description: Remote desktop over RDP with xrdp and XFCE: installation, port, colour depth, security layer, sound, polkit rule, status, restart and switching off

port.label: Port
port.help: TCP port xrdp listens on (port in [Globals] of xrdp.ini).

securityLayer.label: Security layer
securityLayer.help: negotiate lets client and server agree, tls requires TLS, rdp is the classic RDP encryption (security_layer in xrdp.ini).

maxBpp.label: Colour depth
maxBpp.help: Highest colour depth in bits per pixel a client may ask for (max_bpp in xrdp.ini).

sound.label: Sound
sound.help: Install the xrdp module of the sound server, so remote sessions play sound on the client.

desktop.label: Desktop
desktop.help: xfce installs XFCE and starts it in remote sessions; none installs no desktop and leaves the session start as it is.

allowRootLogin.label: Allow root to log in
allowRootLogin.help: Whether root may open a remote session (AllowRootLogin in [Security] of sesman.ini).

polkit.label: polkit rule
polkit.help: Write a rule that answers the password prompts of the listed polkit actions in remote sessions. Switched off, the action removes the rule again.

polkitActions.label: polkit actions
polkitActions.help: Actions the rule allows without a password: colour management and Wi-Fi scans, which ask at every remote login. The rule allows nothing else.

polkitGroup.label: Group of the polkit rule
polkitGroup.help: Members of this group get the rule. Empty: only the user who runs the action.

sessionFile.label: Session start file
sessionFile.help: File the session start of xrdp reads for the user; the desktop is started from a marked block in it.

sessionCommand.label: Session command
sessionCommand.help: Command that starts the desktop in a remote session.

services.label: Services
services.help: systemd units of xrdp, in the order they are started.

packages.label: Packages of xrdp
packages.help: Packages per package manager (apt, dnf, pacman, zypper). An empty list means the distribution ships no package.

desktopPackages.label: Packages of the desktop
desktopPackages.help: Packages per package manager, installed with the desktop xfce.

soundPackages.label: Packages for sound
soundPackages.help: Packages per package manager with the xrdp module of the sound server, e.g. pipewire-module-xrdp or pulseaudio-module-xrdp.

manager.label: Package manager
manager.help: auto takes the first of apt, dnf, pacman and zypper found in PATH.

install.label: Install xrdp
install.description: Installs xrdp and the desktop from the package sources of the distribution.

configure.label: Apply configuration
configure.description: Sets port, security layer, colour depth and root login in xrdp.ini and sesman.ini, and the session start of the desktop.

polkit.label: Write polkit rule
polkit.description: Writes or removes the rule for the password prompts in remote sessions.

sound.label: Set up sound
sound.description: Installs the xrdp module of the sound server when sound is switched on.

enable.label: Switch on
enable.description: Starts xrdp now and at every start of the machine.

restart.label: Restart
restart.confirm: xrdp is restarted. Running remote sessions are disconnected and may end.

disable.label: Switch off
disable.confirm: xrdp is stopped and no longer started with the machine. Running remote sessions end, and the machine is no longer reachable over RDP.
